description.value: Alenka European Foods is a family-run specialty grocery store that has been serving Metro Vancouver since 2009, stocking a carefully curated selection of products from Russia, Ukraine, Georgia, Armenia, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, and other Eastern European countries. The store carries everything from deli meats and dairy to baked goods, frozen meals, preserved foods, and seafood — all from authentic Eastern European producers. It is a genuine neighbourhood grocery destination on Kingsway with an online store offering local pickup.
